bng.text: Minotaurs are sent by Mogis in hordes against human cities, with Akros bearing the brunt.

In a mountain pass, a squad of Akroans finds nine of their people beheaded and butchered, and Xanthos identifies minotaur tracks, then boulders seal the canyon behind them and a minotaur horde charges.
The minotaurs cut down Xanthos, Mnesos and Haemon until the squad kills the huge leader, and the surviving minotaurs scatter, though Diocles realizes they were lured and trapped deliberately.
Leandros runs past fallen squads to Akros, where he discovers the minotaurs have built a wall around the city to keep the Alamon out while they besiege it.
